title: SMK-01 Buyer signs in through the UI in the market language
precondition: Seeded demo data. Market selected via ?market=<code>.
steps:
1. Open /login?market=<code>
2. Sign in as buyer@procurelab.test / Demo123!
expected_result:
1. Login page is shown; html lang equals the market's default language
2. Dashboard opens; body data-market equals the market

title: SMK-02 Dashboard shows KPIs, activity and market settings
steps:
1. Open the dashboard in the market
2. Check recent activity
3. Check the footer
expected_result:
1. KPI cards Projects, Active RFPs, Proposals and Vendors are visible with values above 0
2. At least one activity item is listed
3. Footer shows market code, locale (lang-MARKET) and the market currency

title: SMK-03 Projects list shows the market's projects
steps:
1. Open Projects
2. Open the seeded project
expected_result:
1. The seeded project of the market is listed
2. Project title and its requirements are shown

title: SMK-04 Vendor directory filters by expertise
steps: 1. Open Vendors and filter by expertise Security
expected_result: 1. The market's security vendor is listed and the empty state is not shown

title: SMK-05 Create a project end to end
precondition: Signed in as procurement manager. Unique project data from the data factory.
steps:
1. Open New project and fill all fields with valid data
2. Save
3. (cleanup) Delete the project through the API
expected_result:
1. Form accepts the input
2. Project page opens with the new title and a success message
3. Project no longer exists

title: SMK-06 Proposal prices use the market currency and VAT
precondition: Seeded RFP with proposals in the market.
steps:
1. Open the seeded RFP with proposals
2. Compare each price with the API value
3. Check VAT columns
expected_result:
1. Proposal table is shown
2. Net price is formatted in the market currency and locale
3. If vatBreakdown is on, gross = net x (1 + market VAT); if off, the VAT columns are hidden

title: SMK-07 Language can be switched to English in each market
steps: 1. Switch the language to English
expected_result: 1. Locale becomes en-<market>; navigation shows 'Projects'

title: SMK-08 Vendor sees an open RFP with requirements and documents
precondition: Signed in as the market's vendor user.
steps:
1. Open My RFPs
2. Open the RFP
expected_result:
1. Vendor company name is shown; the open RFP has status Awaiting response
2. Requirements and at least one downloadable document are shown

title: API-01 Health endpoint is up
steps: 1. GET /api/health
expected_result: 1. 200 with status ok

title: API-02 Config exposes all markets with VAT and currency
steps: 1. GET /api/config
expected_result: 1. Markets NL, BE, DK, DE with VAT 21/21/25/19% and DKK for DK

title: API-03 Test data API rejects requests without a token
steps: 1. POST /api/test/reset without x-test-token

title: API-04 Project lifecycle through the API
steps: 1. Create a project with locale data, list, delete
expected_result: 1. Created project is listed, then gone after delete

title: REG-PRJ-01 Mandatory project fields are validated
steps: 1. Open New project and save without input
expected_result: 1. Form is shown again with errors for name, owner, budget, start date and end date

title: REG-PRJ-02 End date before start date is rejected
steps: 1. Fill a valid project but set the end date before the start date and save
expected_result: 1. Only the end date shows an error

title: REG-PRJ-03 Duplicate project names are rejected within a market
precondition: A project exists (created through the API).
steps: 1. Create a project with the same name in the same market
expected_result: 1. Name field shows the duplicate error

title: REG-PRJ-04 Search and status filter
precondition: One planning and one active project exist.
steps:
1. Search by the planning project's name
2. Search the active project's name with status Planning
expected_result:
1. Only that project is listed
2. Empty state is shown

title: REG-PRJ-05 Archive hides a project; restore brings it back
steps:
1. Archive the project
2. Filter by Archived
3. Restore it
expected_result:
1. It disappears from the default list
2. It is listed
3. Status returns to Active

title: REG-PRJ-06 An RFP needs at least one requirement
steps:
1. Open New RFP for the project
2. Add requirement 'Penetration test' (Must have)
expected_result:
1. A message says a requirement must be added first
2. Requirement is listed with its priority

title: PRJ-07 Edit a project and keep its status
steps:
1. Edit the budget and description, save
2. Edit the name to an existing project's name
expected_result:
1. Success message; new values shown in the project header
2. Duplicate error; original name unchanged

title: PRJ-08 Budget is formatted per market
steps: 1. Open Projects in each market
expected_result: 1. Budget uses the market currency and number format (e.g. DKK in DK, EUR with comma decimals in NL/DE)

title: VEN-01 Add a vendor with valid data
steps: 1. Open Add vendor and fill name, location, contact, email, rating 4.2, two expertise areas
expected_result: 1. Vendor is saved and listed with a success message

title: VEN-02 Vendor form validation
steps:
1. Save with rating 7, invalid email and no expertise
2. Boundary: rating 1 and 5
3. Boundary: rating 0.9 and 5.1
expected_result:
1. Errors for rating (1 to 5), email and expertise; nothing saved
2. Both accepted
3. Both rejected

title: VEN-03 Combined search, expertise and rating filters
steps:
1. Search 'ISO 27001' with minimum rating 4.5
2. Filter an expertise nobody has in the market
expected_result:
1. Only vendors with that certification and rating >= 4.5 are listed
2. Empty state is shown

title: VEN-04 Assign a vendor to a project from the vendor page
precondition: A project and a vendor exist.
steps:
1. Open the vendor and assign it to the project
2. Open New RFP for that project
expected_result:
1. Success message; vendor appears under Assigned vendors on the project
2. The assigned vendor is pre-ticked

title: VEN-05 Removing a vendor removes it from project assignments
steps: 1. Remove the vendor
expected_result: 1. It disappears from the directory and from the project's assigned vendors

title: REG-RFP-01 Send an RFP with an attachment
steps: 1. Create an RFP: title, requirements, the market's vendor, deadline +14 days, upload rfp-scope.pdf
expected_result: 1. RFP page opens with a success message and the file listed

title: REG-RFP-02 Disallowed file types are rejected
steps: 1. Upload not-allowed.exe with an otherwise valid RFP
expected_result: 1. Upload error is shown; RFP is not created

title: REG-RFP-03 Vendor responds, buyer compares, analyzes and selects
precondition: Open RFP inviting the market's vendor-login company and one competitor.
steps:
1. Competitor submits through the API without a document
2. Vendor submits 95,000 / 6 months with a document through the portal
3. Buyer opens the RFP and sorts by price
4. Check the analyzer
5. Compare both, then select the vendor
expected_result:
1. Proposal stored
2. Success message; own proposal shown
3. Vendor first, competitor second
4. Vendor 'Complete'; competitor 'Missing: proposal document' and risk not Low
5. Side-by-side view; RFP Awarded; vendor Selected; competitor Not selected

title: RFP-04 RFP form validation
steps: 1. Send without title, requirements, vendors and with a past deadline
expected_result: 1. Four field errors; nothing created

title: RFP-05 Upload size and count limits
steps:
1. Upload a 6 MB PDF
2. Upload 6 files
expected_result:
1. Error mentions the 5 MB limit
2. Error: at most 5 files

title: RFP-06 Compare needs 2 or 3 proposals
steps:
1. Tick 1 proposal and compare
2. Tick 3 and compare
expected_result:
1. Notice: select 2 or 3
2. Side-by-side view with 3 columns

title: REG-VND-01 A second proposal for the same RFP is refused
precondition: Vendor invited to an open RFP.
steps:
1. Submit a proposal
2. Post a second proposal (form replay)
expected_result:
1. Own proposal shown
2. Server answers 409

title: REG-VND-02 A closed RFP no longer accepts proposals
steps: 1. Open the RFP as the invited vendor
expected_result: 1. Closed notice; no proposal form

title: REG-VND-03 Vendors cannot open RFPs they are not invited to, or buyer pages
precondition: RFP that does not invite the vendor.
steps:
1. Open the RFP URL
2. Open /dashboard
expected_result:
1. Not found page
2. 403

title: VND-04 Question and answer flow
steps:
1. Vendor asks a question
2. Buyer answers it on the RFP page
3. Vendor reloads
expected_result:
1. Question listed as Awaiting answer
2. Answer saved
3. Answer is visible to the vendor

title: VND-05 Live VAT preview per market
precondition: Open RFP for the market's vendor.
steps: 1. Type a net price of 1000
expected_result: 1. VAT and total update immediately using the market VAT (or no preview where vatBreakdown is off)

title: VND-06 Competitor documents cannot be downloaded
steps: 1. Vendor requests the competitor file URL
expected_result: 1. 404; no file content returned

title: ANL-01 Deterministic scores for the seeded RFP
steps: 1. Open 'Cloud Migration RFP'
expected_result: 1. CloudTech 91% (Recommended, Low), DataSphere 89% (Medium), DigitalWorks 86% (High, Missing: proposal document)

title: ANL-02 AI summary without configuration
precondition: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set on the app.
steps: 1. Click Generate AI summary
expected_result: 1. Clear 'not configured' notice; rule-based analysis still shown

title: ANL-03 AI summary is faithful (LLM-as-judge)
precondition: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set on the app and the test runner.
steps:
1. Generate the summary
2. Judge it against the facts
expected_result:
1. Summary shown in the current UI language
2. Rubric passes: only real vendors/numbers, correct language, mentions price vs delivery trade-off and missing info

title: REG-ADM-01 Admin creates a user; deactivation signs them out
steps:
1. Create a procurement manager
2. Sign in as the new user in another browser
3. Deactivate the user, then reload their page
expected_result:
1. Success message; user listed
2. Dashboard opens
3. Redirected to login

title: REG-ADM-02 Procurement managers cannot open user administration
steps: 1. Open /admin/users

title: ADM-03 Vendor users are linked to their company's market
steps:
1. Create a vendor user for DataSphere with home market DE
2. Sign in as that user
expected_result:
1. User saved with market NL (the vendor's market)
2. Only DataSphere's RFPs are shown

title: ADM-04 Admin cannot deactivate their own account
steps: 1. Try to deactivate yourself
expected_result: 1. No button for own row; direct POST returns 409 with message

title: ADM-05 Data export contains no password hashes
steps: 1. Download the JSON export
expected_result: 1. File downloads; no 'passwordHash' anywhere; users included

title: REG-I18N-01 Every language defines every UI text
steps: 1. GET /api/i18n
expected_result: 1. No missing keys for en, nl, da, de

title: REG-I18N-02 German RFP form is fully translated
steps: 1. Open New RFP with lang=de
expected_result: 1. Button reads 'Ausschreibung senden' (currently 'Send RFP': marked test.fail until fixed)

title: I18N-03 Feature flags per market
steps:
1. Open the seeded RFP in each market
2. Override with ?ff_aiAnalyzer=on in DE
expected_result:
1. BE: no VAT columns and no analyzer; DE: no analyzer and no questions; NL: all features
2. Analyzer appears for that session
